grammar_note_vi: Nói mức độ thường xuyên: always (luôn luôn), usually (thường), often (hay), sometimes (thỉnh thoảng), never (không bao giờ). Các từ này đứng trước động từ: "I always make my bed."

writing.target: I help with the chores every day.
I make the bed every morning.

text_en: Every Saturday morning, Leo's family cleans their flat together.
Leo's dad vacuums the carpets, and his mum mops the kitchen floor.
Leo's sister, Mia, does the laundry.
She washes, irons and folds the clothes.
Leo always tidies his bedroom and makes his bed.
He also waters the plants on the balcony.
After that, he takes out the rubbish.
When they finish, the flat is neat and clean.
Then the family goes to the park for a picnic.
Leo thinks chores are boring, but he likes the picnic!

questions.q: What does Leo do on the balcony?
What does the family do after the chores?
options: They have a picnic in the park.
questions.answer: They have a picnic in the park.
